workshop_summary: Dedicated capacity sizing workshop run with Delta Arc ML infra + product leads. Goal: size committed GPU pool to meet conversational personalization throughput while holding interactive latency SLOs. Captured workload shape (steady vs burst), token distributions, target p95 latency, and operational requirements (region, KMS, audit).
sizing_assumptions: Average request: 250 prompt tokens + 120 generated tokens = 370 tokens per request
Baseline steady-state QPS: 18 qps (business hours traffic)
Expected engineering growth + daily peaks: target peak QPS 180 (10x burst factor)
Design peak tokens/sec target (10x burst): 66,600 toks/sec
latency_slos: Interactive chat target: p50 <= 80ms, p95 <= 300ms (end-to-end model response)
Embedding throughput target: batch throughput >= 2,000 embeds/sec (background)
recommended_capacity: Committed pool: 6 x NVIDIA H100 80GB (in-region) — supports baseline + sustained throughput with 20% headroom
Burst pool: 3 x H100 pre-warmed on demand (autoscale/burst credits) to absorb 3x short spikes
Fallback variants: quantized smaller model (q4f16) for sub-100ms critical paths
KV/prefix caching enabled for top-20% queries to reduce repeated token generation
Model routing policy: primary H100 for large-context runs; L4/L40 fleet for low-cost short turn conversations
throughput_guarantees_and_sla_items: Throughput guarantee: committed pool to sustain 60 qps at p95 <= 300ms for 95% of observed windows
Burst policy: allow up to 3x committed capacity for 30s windows using burst credits; additional usage billed at overage rate
Uptime SLA: 99.9% for Dedicated control plane and inference endpoints; crediting model for downtime > SLA
Data residency: single-region (us-east-1) physical allocation requested
Audit & logging: 90-day request/response logging retention behind customer KMS; logs accessible via console/export
po\u0441_plan_and_acceptance_criteria: 4‑week PoC: benchmark using production traces (sanitized) + synthetic bursts; Redwood to run YCSB-style load harness
Week 1: baseline profiling (token-level), Week 2: model tuning + quantization test, Week 3: load soak at steady-state, Week 4: burst/chaos testing
Acceptance: p95 latency under SLO for 95% of 1‑hour windows for steady-state; no data residency or KMS blockers unresolved
Deliverables: performance report, cost/runbook, quantization recommendations
commercial_notes: Delta Arc prefers a blended committed capacity + burst credits commercial model. Wants 12‑month commitment with quarterly review and right to scale. Legal requested dedicated wording around audit access and incident notification windows.
